description: Measures the consequence of the qou-hu1f intra-ordering finding. On the canonical chain the character ratio R_nucleon = tr_M(W_atom)/tr_M(W_free) is identical under the grouped and interleaved orderings to ~1e-60 at A = 2, 3, 4, and equals prod_i (z + d_i) under both, because connected-sum multiplicativity is blind to letter order inside a block. So L and the bond constants cannot move. Absolute traces do move: R_quark falls by 3.785x (2H), 7.868x (3H), 6.891x (3He), 14.325x (4He) when the intra block is rebuilt as beta_Bor, and binding_canonical's Delta_tr = R_quark (1 - prod(z+d)) moves by the same factor. The per-generator factorisation form stated in rem:canonical-trace-factorises-over-chain holds only for the grouped word (3e-59 vs a 2.8x-13.3x failure), though the arc's conclusion rests on connected sum and survives. The unblocked two-level character ratio gives 2H +254.53 %, 3H +74.49 %, 3He +53.87 %, 4He -33.60 %: it does not work, and is worse than the grouped word below A = 4. No fitting.
caveats: Chain word only. The all-pairs variant is a different object and is retired as ill-posed (qou-bygw); its ratio invariance is NOT tested here.
Two of the three levels. prf:confined-knot-binding also names a nuclear-jet level, which has no word.
